rules.name: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rules.description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "bola" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: API2: Broken Authentication — Default Credentials
rules.description: Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "authentication" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: API3: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
rules.description: Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "bopla" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: API4: Unrestricted Resource Consumption — Rate Limiting

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "rate-limiting" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: API5: Broken Function Level Authorization

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "business-flows" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "misconfiguration" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
